name_zh: 泰国·拉玛五世朱拉隆功：奴隶废除与现代化改革
name_en: Thailand Rama V Chulalongkorn: Slavery Abolition & Modernization Reform
description_zh: 朱拉隆功 (1853-1910) 暹罗拉玛五世 (1868-1910)，废除奴隶制、腓特列制度，推行行政、法律、教育、铁路现代化，以灵活外交避免殖民，奠定泰国现代国家基础。
description_en: Chulalongkorn (1853-1910) Siam Rama V (1868-1910), abolished slavery and corvee, implemented administrative legal education railway modernization, avoided colonization through flexible diplomacy, laid modern Thai state foundation.
reason_zh: 朱拉隆功代表东南亚唯一未被殖民国家的现代化转型典范，展示了绝对君主如何通过自上而下改革实现国家主权保全与现代化双重目标。
reason_en: Chulalongkorn represents Southeast Asia only uncolonized nation modernization paradigm, demonstrating how absolute monarch achieves both sovereignty preservation and modernization through top-down reform.
steps_zh: 研究朱拉隆功早年蒙库特王父改革遗产与摄政期
分析1874废除腓特列与1905废除奴隶制渐进路径
探讨月圈改革行政划分与法律法典编纂
评估铁路建设与曼谷城市化现代化
总结灵活外交周旋英法殖民势力保全主权
steps_en: Study Chulalongkorn early Mongkut father reform legacy and regency
Analyze 1874 corvee abolition and 1905 slavery abolition gradual path
Explore Monthon reform administrative division and legal code compilation
Evaluate railway construction and Bangkok urbanization modernization
Summarize flexible diplomacy maneuvering British French colonial powers preserving sovereignty
expected_zh: 掌握朱拉隆功渐进改革与外交平衡双重策略，理解东南亚唯一独立国家现代化路径，评估其对当代泰国国家建构的奠基作用。
expected_en: Master Chulalongkorn gradual reform and diplomatic balance dual strategy, understand Southeast Asia only independent nation modernization path, evaluate its foundational role for contemporary Thai state construction.
case_zh: 1868 即位；1874 废除腓特列；1905 废除奴隶制；1910 逝世。奴隶废除现代化改革范式永存。
case_en: 1868 accession; 1874 corvee abolished; 1905 slavery abolished; 1910 death. Slavery abolition modernization paradigm endures.
cross_cultural_impact: Uncolonized modernization model; slavery abolition; railway; legal reform
